blocks.title: Match a secant
blocks.problem: Find the MVT point for $\sqrt x$ on $[0,9]$.

steps.title: Check hypotheses
steps.md: $\sqrt{x}$ is continuous on $[0,9]$ and differentiable for $0<x<9$.
steps.why: The derivative at zero is unnecessary.

steps.title: Solve
steps.md: The secant slope is $1/3$, so $1/(2\sqrt c)=1/3$.
steps.why: The tangent slope must equal the secant slope.

steps.title: Check interval
steps.why: The theorem requires an interior input.

steps.title: Multiply bounds
steps.why: Multiplication by a positive interval length preserves inequalities.
